errors.text_span: The “Vanilla” model (purple, solid line) consistently shows the lowest loss across iterations
errors.evidence: Vanilla is not the lowest curve; the purple Vanilla line lies below the other curves only in the early portion, but by the end the red SepLLM (n=64, H/T) and another SepLLM curve are at or below it. The statement maps the wrong relative position as consistently lowest.
The SepLLM (n=128) curve is plotted in light blue/cyan, not dark blue. The dark blue/purple-toned curve corresponds to a different SepLLM variant.
The Vanilla curve ends closer to about 2.49–2.50, but the text’s broader issue is that it is described as the lowest across iterations; the relative ordering is incorrect.
The description omits the prominent shaded uncertainty/band around each line, which is visible in the figure.
